title: Why You Must Weigh Yourself Daily
hook: You have to weigh yourself every single day. Trying to get abs without weighing yourself daily is like trying to get rich while never looking at your bank account.
body:
First, you catch fat gain while it's still small. Two pounds is one bad weekend, and you fix it in three days. Ten pounds is four months of dieting to undo.

Second, you learn what actually makes you gain weight. Watch the number after a night of drinking, after bad sleep and after a restaurant meal. Within four weeks you'll know your problem foods from your own data.

Third, it takes 10 seconds. Weigh in first thing after the bathroom, before you eat or drink anything, and never react to one day. Watch the weekly average, because your weight swings three pounds on water alone.
